tools.name: GetDebugState
tools.description: Returns the current debugger state: whether a binary is loaded, whether it is running or paused, the PID, current instruction pointer, and current module. Always available. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: LoadBinary
tools.description: Loads an executable into the debugger for a new debugging session. Equivalent to File > Open in the GUI. If a session is already active it is terminated first. The debuggee pauses at the system breakpoint.

filePath.description: Absolute file path of the executable to debug.

tools.name: ExecuteDebuggerCommand
tools.description: Executes a native x64dbg command string (like 'erun', 'analr', 'graph'). This is for x64dbg-internal commands ONLY — do NOT pass MCP tool names here. MCP tools (WaitForEvent, GetDebugState, Disassemble, etc.) must be called directly as tools.

tools.name: ListCommandsByCategory
tools.description: Lists the available MCP tools, optionally filtered to a single category.

tools.name: SearchForStrings
tools.description: Searches process memory for a specific text string and returns the addresses where it occurs.

searchText.description: The literal text to search for.

tools.name: GetEventLog
tools.description: Returns the last N debugger events (exceptions, breakpoints, DLL loads, thread events, etc.). Keeps the last 64 events in a ring buffer. Use this to see what happened in x64dbg.

count.description: Number of most recent events to return (default: all, max 64).

tools.name: ClearEventLog
tools.description: Clears the event log ring buffer.

tools.name: EvalExpression
tools.description: Evaluates an x64dbg expression (address, register, arithmetic, symbol) and returns the result in hex and decimal.

tools.name: AttachProcess
tools.description: Attaches the debugger to a running process by PID.

tools.name: Echo
tools.description: Echoes the input back to the client.

tools.name: WaitForEvent
tools.description: Blocks until a debugger event fires (breakpoint hit, paused, resumed, exception, session start/stop) or timeout. Returns all events that occurred. Use this to monitor debugger state changes in real-time over HTTP — call it after 'run' or while waiting for the user to interact with the debugger.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds (default 30000, max 120000).

tools.name: GetCurrentAddress
tools.description: Returns the current instruction pointer (EIP/RIP), the module it belongs to, and its label/comment. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: ReadMemory
tools.description: Reads raw bytes from the target process memory and returns a hex dump with ASCII. Example: ReadMemory address=0x7FF600001000, size=128

address.description: Hex address or expression to read from.

tools.name: WaitForPause
tools.description: Blocks until the debuggee stops running (hits a breakpoint, exception, or exits). Returns the reason for the pause and the current address. Use after 'run' to wait for the target to break.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Resumes execution and waits for the target to pause (breakpoint, exception, or exit). Blocks until a pause event occurs or timeout. Use timeoutMs to control how long to wait (default 120s). Always returns the reason for the pause and current state.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for target to pause after resuming (default 300000ms = 5 minutes, max 600000ms = 10 minutes). The tool blocks until a breakpoint/exception fires or timeout.

tools.name: StepInto
tools.description: Executes a single instruction, stepping INTO any call encountered (F7). Takes no arguments.

tools.name: StepOver
tools.description: Executes a single instruction, stepping OVER any call/subroutine entirely (F8). Takes no arguments.

tools.name: StepOut
tools.description: Runs until the current function returns to its caller (Ctrl+F9). Takes no arguments.

tools.name: PauseDebug
tools.description: Pauses (suspends) the running debuggee, equivalent to Debug > Pause (F12). Takes no arguments.

tools.name: StopDebug
tools.description: Terminates the current debugging session and closes the debuggee process. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: RestartDebug
tools.description: Restarts the current debugging session from the beginning. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: SetBreakpoint
tools.description: Sets a software execution breakpoint (INT3) at an address or API symbol.

target.description: Hex address or API symbol to break on.

tools.name: DeleteBreakpoint
tools.description: Removes a breakpoint at an address or API symbol.

target.description: Hex address or API symbol of the breakpoint to remove.

tools.name: GetAllRegisters
tools.description: Returns the current values of all general-purpose registers. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: GetCallStack
tools.description: Returns the current thread's call stack. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: WriteMemToAddress
tools.description: Patches memory by writing raw hex bytes to an address. WARNING: this modifies the live process. Example: WriteMemToAddress address=0x12345678, byteString=0F FF 90

byteString.description: Hex bytes to write, e.g. '0F FF 90'.

tools.name: CommentOrLabelAtAddress
tools.description: Adds a comment or a label at a specific address in the disassembly.

tools.name: Disassemble
tools.description: Disassembles instructions at an address. Returns instruction mnemonics with addresses. Default: 10 instructions from current IP.

tools.name: ListModules
tools.description: Lists all loaded modules (DLLs/EXE) with base addresses and sizes.

tools.name: ListBreakpoints
tools.description: Lists all active breakpoints (software, hardware, and memory).

tools.name: GetMemoryMap
tools.description: Returns the memory map showing all memory regions with base address, size, protection, and module info.

tools.name: SetRegister
tools.description: Sets the value of a CPU register.

tools.name: GetThreads
tools.description: Lists all threads in the debugged process with IDs, instruction pointers, and names.

tools.name: SwitchThread
tools.description: Switches the debugger's active thread context to a different thread.

tools.name: Assemble
tools.description: Assembles an instruction at a specific address, replacing existing bytes.

instruction.description: Assembly instruction (e.g. nop, mov eax 1, jmp 0x401000).

tools.name: GetImports
tools.description: Shows the import table of a loaded module.

tools.name: GetExports
tools.description: Shows the export table of a loaded module.

tools.name: SetHardwareBreakpoint
tools.description: Sets a hardware breakpoint using debug registers (DR0-DR3). Supports read, write, and execute types.

tools.name: SetMemoryBreakpoint
tools.description: Sets a memory breakpoint at an address. Triggers when memory is accessed (read/write/execute). Uses guard pages — slower than hardware breakpoints but no DR register limit.

type.description: Type: r (read/access), w (write), x (execute). Default: access (any).

singleshoot.description: If true, breakpoint is removed after first hit (default false).

tools.name: GetPatches
tools.description: Lists all memory patches applied to the debugged process.

tools.name: FindPattern
tools.description: Scans module memory for a byte pattern with ?? wildcards. Returns matching addresses. Example: FindPattern pattern='E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 85 C0 74'

pattern.description: Hex bytes with ?? wildcards, e.g. 'E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 85 C0'.

tools.name: GetStrings
tools.description: Scans a module's memory for ASCII strings and returns them with their addresses.

tools.name: GetReferences
tools.description: Finds code references (CALL/JMP) to a target address within a module.

address.description: Target address to find references to.

module.description: Module to search in (default: main exe).

tools.name: GetFunctions
tools.description: Lists analyzed functions in a module with start addresses, sizes, and labels. Requires prior analysis (Ctrl+A in x64dbg).

tools.name: RunToAddress
tools.description: Sets a temporary breakpoint at the target address, resumes execution, and waits for the debuggee to hit it.

tools.name: TraceInto
tools.description: Single-steps N instructions recording the address and disassembly of each. Max 100.

tools.name: SetConditionalBreakpoint
tools.description: Sets a breakpoint with a condition expression and optional log text.

tools.name: FollowPointer
tools.description: Dereferences a pointer chain N levels deep, showing each level's address and value with module info.

tools.name: WatchExpressions
tools.description: Evaluates multiple x64dbg expressions at once and returns all results. Pass comma-separated expressions.

tools.name: GetSEHChain
tools.description: Walks the Structured Exception Handler chain (x32 only) and shows each handler's address and module.

tools.name: GetPEB
tools.description: Reads key fields from the Process Environment Block: image base, being debugged, heaps, NtGlobalFlag, image path, command line.

tools.name: GetArguments
tools.description: Reads function arguments from the stack (x32: [ESP+4]...) or registers (x64: RCX,RDX,R8,R9...) at the current position.

count.description: Number of args to read (default 4, max 16).

tools.name: DumpMemory
tools.description: Saves a memory region to a file on disk.

tools.name: AllocateMemory
tools.description: Allocates a block of memory in the target process.

protection.description: Memory protection: rwx, rw, rx, r (default rw).

tools.name: FreeMemory
tools.description: Frees a previously allocated memory block in the target process.

address.description: Base address of the allocated block to free.

tools.name: EnableBreakpoint
tools.description: Enables a breakpoint at a given address.

tools.name: DisableBreakpoint
tools.description: Disables a breakpoint at a given address without deleting it.

tools.name: ToggleBreakpoint
tools.description: Toggles a breakpoint between enabled and disabled.

tools.name: DeleteAllBreakpoints
tools.description: Removes all breakpoints (normal, hardware, and memory).

tools.name: ResetHitCount
tools.description: Resets the hit counter of a breakpoint at the given address to zero.

tools.name: DisassembleFunction
tools.description: Disassembles an entire function by finding its start/end boundaries from the analysis database.

tools.name: SearchSymbols
tools.description: Searches for symbols (labels) matching a pattern in a module.

pattern.description: Symbol name pattern to search for (substring match).

module.description: Module to search in (default: all modules).

tools.name: ListSymbols
tools.description: Lists exported symbols of a module.

module.description: Module name to list symbols from.

tools.name: SuspendThread
tools.description: Suspends a thread by its thread ID.

tools.name: ResumeThread
tools.description: Resumes a suspended thread by its thread ID.

tools.name: SetBookmark
tools.description: Sets a bookmark at the specified address.

tools.name: DeleteBookmark
tools.description: Deletes a bookmark at the specified address.

tools.name: ListBookmarks
tools.description: Lists all bookmarks with addresses and labels.

tools.name: DumpModule
tools.description: Dumps an entire loaded module to a file on disk.

tools.name: AnalyzeModule
tools.description: Shows PE structure analysis: sections, entry point, image size, characteristics.

tools.name: DetectOEP
tools.description: Attempts to detect the Original Entry Point for packed executables by analyzing section characteristics.

tools.name: GetDumpableRegions
tools.description: Lists memory regions that can be dumped (committed, readable) for a module or the entire process.

tools.name: RestorePatches
tools.description: Restores all patched bytes back to their original values.

tools.name: SetExceptionBreakpoint
tools.description: Controls how an exception code is handled: break into debugger or pass to application. Use this to ignore Delphi (0EEDFADE), C++ (E06D7363), or other framework exceptions during startup, or to break on specific exceptions like ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION (C000001D).

exceptionCode.description: Exception code in hex (e.g. C000001D, 0EEDFADE, E06D7363).

action.description: break = break into debugger, ignore = pass to application (default break).

tools.name: DeleteExceptionBreakpoint
tools.description: Removes an exception breakpoint, restoring default handling for that exception code.

exceptionCode.description: Exception code in hex to delete.

tools.name: AnalyzeCode
tools.description: Runs x64dbg code analysis on a module or address range. This populates the function list, enables GetFunctions/GetReferences/DisassembleFunction. Must be run before those tools return useful results.

address.description: Address or module to analyze. If omitted, analyzes the current module.

type.description: Analysis type: 'function' (analr - analyze single function), 'module' (anal - analyze module), 'controlflow' (cfanal - control flow analysis). Default: module.

tools.name: TraceOver
tools.description: Steps N instructions stepping OVER calls (like TraceInto but without diving into subroutines). Records address and disassembly of each step.

tools.name: SetBreakpointCommand
tools.description: Sets an x64dbg command to execute when a breakpoint at the given address is hit. Use for logging breakpoints (e.g., 'log {x:eax}' to log register values on hit).

command.description: x64dbg command to run on hit (e.g. 'log {x:eax}', 'msg {utf8@[esp+4]}').

tools.name: SetBreakpointFastResume
tools.description: Makes a breakpoint auto-resume after hit without pausing. Combined with SetBreakpointCommand, creates logging breakpoints that record state at thousands of call sites without stopping.

enable.description: true to enable fast resume, false to disable.

tools.name: SaveDatabase
tools.description: Saves the x64dbg database (labels, comments, breakpoints, analysis) for the current module. Persists your work across sessions.
